title: Knobby Silky Slovakian Potatoes Toast
description: A salty and silky solo dinner dish featuring floury potatoes and toast, inspired by Slovakian cuisine and suitable for Jain dietary preferences. This dish is easy to prepare and can be ready in under an hour.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Wash and peel the potatoes, then cut them into 1-inch cubes.
Place the potatoes in a large bowl and toss with 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and paprika until they are evenly coated.
Spread the potatoes out in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes, or until they are tender and lightly browned.
While the potatoes are roasting, toast the bread slices until they are lightly browned and crispy.
Once the potatoes are done, remove them from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
To assemble the dish, place a toasted bread slice on a plate, then top with a portion of the roasted potatoes.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley if desired and serve immediately.
